# Original native screenplay subset corpus for #424

All story text in these three files was newly authored for this checkpoint and
uses the repository's MIT license. No external screenplay, converter output,
font, executable, or model is included. The files are authored source fixtures,
not native-application exports or successful converter qualification evidence.

The bodies have matching ordered semantics in the explicitly accepted subset:
scene heading, action, character, parenthetical, dialogue, and transition. The
FDX envelope is the inspected version-1 `Script` / `No` shape. The OSF envelope
is the inspected version-20 shape with `basestylename`.

The independent reader decodes a parenthetical's one outer pair of parentheses
as syntax; canonical text is `softly` for all three. It does not fold case, trim
nonempty paragraph text, concatenate text runs, or discard unknown elements.
FDX `Empty` paragraphs may contain only whitespace; those are treated as
spacing/layout, not as body text. Native layout is not preserved by Fountain.

Fade In wrapper cases are authored in the Rust tests using `ZipWriter` around
these OSF bytes. The profile accepts exactly one regular, unencrypted root
member named `document.xml`, stored or deflated, within a 16 MiB uncompressed
limit. There is no checked-in binary generated by a native application.

All parsing tests, converter execution, native application checks, builds,
formatting/linting, and CI are deferred. Source references and rejected route
directions are recorded in `docs/work/424/PROVIDER_EVALUATION.md`.
